mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.cart_code, c.status FROM wms_cart c LEFT JOIN wms_cart_inventory i ON i.cart_id = c.id WHERE i.id IS NULL AND c.status <> 4 ORDER BY c.cart_code ASC

SELECT i.point_id, i.point_code, p.point_name, l.location_name, a.aisle_name FROM wms_cart_inventory i JOIN wms_point p ON p.id = i.point_id LEFT JOIN wms_location l ON l.id = i.location_id LEFT JOIN wms_aisle a ON a.id = i.aisle_id WHERE i.cart_id IS NULL AND i.lock_status = 0 ORDER BY i.aisle_id ASC, i.point_code ASC
SELECT l.id, l.location_name FROM wms_location l ORDER BY l.location_code ASC
SELECT a.id, a.aisle_name, a.location_id FROM wms_aisle a ORDER BY a.aisle_code ASC
